title: 8x8 User Edition Public State Receipt
description: A tamper-evident receipt binding a public-state.json snapshot to a specific git revision. The receipt is independently verifiable from public repository data alone.

schema_version.description: Semver version of the receipt schema.

receipt_id.description: A unique, human-readable identifier for this receipt. Recommended format: <product>-<release>-<YYYYMMDD>.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which this receipt was issued.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA that this receipt covers.

state_file.description: Repository-relative path to the state file captured in this receipt.

state_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the raw bytes of the state file at the named commit, using the algorithm specified in hash_algorithm.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for state_hash and receipt_hash.

state_assertions.description: A subset of key boolean assertions extracted from the state file. These are embedded to allow offline verification of critical boundary flags without reading the full state file.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON of this receipt document with the receipt_hash field omitted (keys sorted, no extra whitespace). Allows detection of any post-issuance tampering.
